subject: changing legend tilte with conditional coloring

messages.author: a5a00d66c8e6ecb7
messages.subject: changing legend tilte with conditional coloring
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to create a scatter plot with conditional coloring.
the colors should be red when the ratio is above 2, blue when it is below -2 and black otherwise.

this is my data
> head (LFQ)
        distLFQ  proxLFQ Gene namesLFQ    ratio
A3QMB7 22.96812 19.00000                3.96812
A3QMC2 25.64906 25.59939          AP-1  0.04967
A3QMC5 28.60011 28.03507        rpl-34  0.56504
A3QMC6 23.59594 23.78632         erl-1 -0.19038
A4F319 24.24336 24.97832               -0.73496
A4LBC3 21.46309 19.00000         met-1  2.46309


This is how I wrote it till now:

ggplot(LFQ, aes(x=distLFQ, y=proxLFQ))+
  color=ifelse(LFQ$ratio>=2 ,"red", ifelse(LFQ$ratio<=-2, "blue", "black"))) +
  geom_point(aes(colour=ifelse(LFQ$ratio>=2 ,"red", ifelse(LFQ$ratio<=-2, "blue", "black"))))

But this doesn't give me exactly what I need.
First I don't have the right colors. How can I specifiy the excat colours I want to have?
second the legend tilte is "ifelse(LFQ$ratio>=2 ,"red", ifelse(LFQ$ratio<=-2, "blue", "black")))". Is there a way to change that?
All I found out is how to completely delete the legend with that:
  theme(legend.title=element_blank())

But I want to show the three categories

thanks

Assa

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: changing legend tilte with conditional coloring

Hadley

messages.author: a5a00d66c8e6ecb7
messages.subject: Re: changing legend tilte with conditional coloring
parts:
thanks Hadley,

this is how I solved it

>LFQ$category <- as.factor(ifelse(LFQ$ratio>=2, "1", ifelse(LFQ$ratio<=-2, "-1", "0")))
# to create factors for the colour scale
>head(LFQ)
        distLFQ  proxLFQ Gene namesLFQ    ratio category
A3QMB7 22.96812 19.00000                3.96812        1
A3QMC2 25.64906 25.59939          AP-1  0.04967        0
A3QMC5 28.60011 28.03507        rpl-34  0.56504        0
A3QMC6 23.59594 23.78632         erl-1 -0.19038        0
A4F319 24.24336 24.97832               -0.73496        0
A4LBC3 21.46309 19.00000         met-1  2.46309        1

ggplot(LFQ) +
  geom_point(aes(y=distLFQ, x=proxLFQ, colour=LFQ$category)) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "enrichment",
                      breaks = c(1, 0, -1),
                      values = c("blue", "black", "red"),
                      labels = c("up","no enrichent", "down"))


Assa
